newsitem.title: USA: Wm. Wrigley Jr Co Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Wm. Wrigley Jr Co Q1 net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q1 1997 net income includes after-tax charge of $900,000 for closure of factory in Santa Cruz, Calif. Excluding charge, Q1 1997 income was $64 million or $0.55 a share.

Q1 1997 revenues reflect net sales and exclude investment and other income of $3,556,000 vs year-ago investment and other income of $3,181,000. Q1 1997 total revenues including investment and other income $451.2 million vs $429.9 million.

Higher Q1 1997 net sales reflects international volume gains and some selective price increases, company said. The gain was partially offset by softer domestic sales and translation of international results to a stronger U.S. dollar.
